namespaces.meaning: A specific, demonstrable skill of a person or team. It is not a technical permission or an overall rating of the person.
An operational profile that gives the AI questions, limits, paths and escalation steps for a situation. It is not a final political decision.
A narrowly limited technical capability of a page module. It never replaces Supabase RLS or a legitimate permission_grant.

non_escalation_rules.rule: A human skill never automatically grants technical write, administration or data access permissions.
An AI operational profile structures navigation and checks, but grants neither political authority nor data access.
A module permission controls only the page renderer. Backend access remains additionally protected by sign-in, permission_grants and Row Level Security.
There is no implicit or transitive inheritance of permissions between human_skill, ai_operation and module_permission.

capabilities.title: Read public Community data
capabilities.description: Reads explicitly published Community test data from an approved same-origin JSON source.
capabilities.scope: public community collections declared by the page document

capabilities.title: Offer internal navigation
capabilities.description: Generates validated links within the website; script and data URLs remain blocked.

capabilities.title: Use decorative motion
capabilities.description: Activates registered animation patterns only and respects the operating system's reduced-motion preference.
